text.content:
Old, big, and united against outsiders.

Turf: Little China, Kabuki, Japantown; reaching into Charter Hill
Known for: Factions that fight each other but close ranks against outsiders
Hangouts: Ho-Oh casino, Deravaja Dojo

One of the oldest gangs in Night City, grown out of the Tiger's Claw, an Arasaka-backed motorcycle club. When Arasaka left the city after the 4th Corporate War, the gang rebranded and moved into the gap.

It's big enough for rival factions to compete for money and turf, but anyone from outside who steps in faces a united front.

Gig hooks

  • A Claws faction wants a rival faction's casino skimmed, and the blame laid on the Mox.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.26
